description: PSE, the Polish electricity transmission system operator, publishes information on the work of the national power system (KSE) on its system data pages. Items listed include a system description and network diagram, durations of supply interruptions, lists of facilities planned for connection, information on available connection capacity, the share of renewable electricity, maintenance tasks planned for 2026 to 2030, generation resources of the KSE, a register of electricity storage, operating plans and cross-border exchange plans, and daily reports on system operation. Because of new information requirements for the electricity market and system operation, all new and modified reports have moved to a separate site, raporty.pse.pl, titled Raporty OSP / Market Data, which is rendered with JavaScript. Coverage is Poland. Pages and reports are free to view; no data licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: content is split between the legacy pages and the new report site, and much is in Polish. Simulation uses are Polish transmission network, generation and connection capacity information for power flow and adequacy models, and outage planning. Related records: data-pse-transmission-supply-continuity-indicators covers interruption indicators, and data-entsoe-transparency-platform carries European market data for Poland.
